newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group April 30 qtr sales up.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group April 30 qtr sales up.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said Tuesday that sales for the quarter ended April 30 were $364,726,000 compared to sales of $156,528,000 for the quarter ended April 30, 1996.

The company said the increase is due to Shoppers Food Warehouse being fully consolidated in Dart's sales for the quarter ended April 30, 1997 as the result of Dart's acquisition of the remaining 50 percent equity in Shoppers Food Warehouse on Feb. 6, 1997.
The company said sales for Shoppers Food Warehouse for the 13 weeks ended May 3, 1997 were $210,204,000 compared to $209,164,000 for the 13 weeks ended May 4, 1996.
Sales for Trak Auto, Crown Books and Total Beverage decreased 1.3 percent to $154,522,000 for the 13 weeks ended May 3, 1997 from $156,528,000 for the 13 weeks ended May 4, 1996, the company said.
Comparable store sales including Shoppers Food decreased 2.5 percent for the quarter ended April 30, 1997 over the same period one year ago, Dart said.
Dart said it owns about 52 percent of Crown Books, 67 percent of Trak Auto, 100 percent of Shoppers Food Warehouse and 100 percent of Total Beverage.
